tool_input.description: Switch ledger writer to a single stream and run its tests

tool_input.command: for i in 1 2 3 4; do dotnet test --configuration Release --no-build 2>&1 | grep -E "^\s+Failed |Passed:|Failed:"; done; git stash -q && dotnet test --configuration Release 2>&1 | grep -E "^\s+Failed |Passed:|Failed:|took"; git stash pop -q && git status --short
tool_input.description: Repeat the suite, then compare against the unmodified code

result:
- **Cause:** The last commit (`7b01276`) made `LedgerWriter.Write` call `File.AppendAllText` once per invoice, so the file is opened and closed 3000 times. In CI the test writes to the accounting staging share (`LEDGER_STAGING_DIR`), where each open/close is slow, hence 351 ms against a 200 ms budget.
- **Action:** In `src/Storefront/Invoices/LedgerWriter.cs`, I replaced the per-line append with a single `StreamWriter` that stays open for the whole write. It still streams line by line, so the ledger is never held in memory. The test and its budget are unchanged.

The change is not committed or pushed, so the pipeline is not green yet. All three `LedgerWriterTests` pass locally, but only against the local temp directory; I could not time it against the staging share.

Two other tests failed intermittently across three local full-suite runs (one run was fully green), and either can turn the pipeline red again:
- **`CatalogTests.Catalog_ReturnsListPrice_ForKnownSku`** (failed in 2 of 3 runs): got 10.00 instead of 12.50. The likely cause is that `PromotionTests` leaves the MUG promo price in the static `PriceCache`, so the result depends on test order.
- **`CheckoutServiceTests.Checkout_NumbersInvoicesUniquely_WhenCheckoutsRunInParallel`** (failed in 1 of 3 runs): not investigated.

I left both alone because they are outside the reported failure.
